description.value: A family-owned craft brewery in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood with two side-by-side tasting rooms on West 8th Avenue. Their core lineup spans amber lagers to Belgian tripels, including a World Beer Cup Silver Award-winning Belgian Tripel. Walk-in only with a casual, spacious atmosphere and seasonal food offerings.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 46m; rack at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 8 spaces.
